authority: Parent is integration owner and keeps all verdict, release and admission authority. This disposition grants no launch, qualification, canonical audit, release or admission.

irc_rulings: Pure capture API unchanged; no extra API fields or synthetic bypass; state the trusted-parent adapter precondition explicitly.
FIXTURE expectation.resolved_argv binds the actual approved instrumented invocation incl. budget 2 vs 240; production B-BAD_PIN provides schema/expected-exit only.

Synthetic negatives need a parent-owned verified derivation manifest preserving the genuine upstream receipt/actual exit and labelling the altered predicate input; the adapter validates it before calling the same X1-X7 code.
An arbitrary modified receipt hash does not establish runtime truth; no source/consumer/fixture PASS gives a canonical audit.

Agreed: X2 byte equality vs X5 canonical-line schema; approved ext3 sensitivity provenance does not artificially produce X7, source/hash mismatch belongs to X5; census hits live in settlement.unresolved.
Expected per-case causes are frozen by the parent adapter/test plan, not retroactively assumed from the old mapping. No API additions or runtime now.

module.creation: exclusive create (Python open mode 'xb'), one write, readback byte-equality; no other file touched
module.public_api: audit_capture(expectation: dict, observed: dict, read_bytes: callable) -> list[str]
module.import_behaviour: imports hashlib and defines constants/functions only: no read, write, process, clock or environment access at import

api.returns: ordered unique subset of CAUSE_ORDER = [X1 EXIT_MISMATCH, X2 STDOUT_CAPTURE_MISSING, X2 STDOUT_CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE, X2 STDOUT_NOT_EXACT_RESULT_LINE, X3 STDERR_CAPTURE_MISSING, X3 STDERR_CAPTURE_INCOMPLETE, X3 STDERR_NONEMPTY, X4 ARTIFACT_SET_OR_DIGEST, X6 UNSETTLED, X7 PROVENANCE]; X5 is audit_schema's; the parent merges both lists in X1..X7 order
api.no_side_effects: no verdict, file write, process, /bin/date or receipt-content parsing
api.read_bytes: called as read_bytes(path, 16777216) only at expectation-bound normalized absolute paths, at most once per path per call, in evaluation order X2 (stdout capture, then result.json if the capture is complete), X3, X4 (names sorted), X7 (receipt, source pins sorted, input pins sorted). Must return exact bytes of length <= cap or raise OSError/ValueError; any other result counts as unreadable; any other exception propagates.

trusted_parent_adapter_precondition: audit_capture judges only consistency between two parent-supplied records and the bytes read_bytes returns. It cannot distinguish genuine from synthetic evidence and never establishes runtime truth.

expectation is parent authority, never child self-report: PLAN from the plan v5 item and its exact GO; FIXTURE from the separately approved instrumented invocation, whose resolved_argv binds that actual command line including --budget-s 2 vs 240. Production B-BAD_PIN supplies only the compared status/schema/expected-exit oracle.

observed is parent-owned evidence: actual_exit is the parent-observed nested science child exit status (negative = signal), distinct from any supervisor/driver exit; capture records map the actual capture files without ignored duplicate fields; census hits and unresolved identities go into settlement.unresolved and every stop signal into settlement.signals; plan_sha256/item/mode/go_sha256 are parent attestations.

Synthetic negatives: the parent first verifies its immutable derivation manifest (genuine upstream receipt and actual exit preserved; altered predicate input exactly labelled) and only then calls this same function. No synthetic bypass, no extra field; a synthetic exit such as 120 is never measured exit evidence.
A receipt hash match proves only byte identity of the file at receipt_path with the parent-bound digest. Endedness comes only from settlement, never from a receipt label.

read_bytes is the contract's descriptor-anchored, cap+1-bounded reader retaining actual identity evidence; a test snapshot callback must be explicitly labelled immutable snapshot evaluation, never kernel evidence, and must raise FileNotFoundError (not KeyError) for an absent path.
The parent supplies only successful owned /bin/date records as date_start/date_end; the module checks nonempty JSON objects and exact typed equality, not their inner semantics.

[] means no owned cause fired. It is not a verdict, not X5, not a canonical audit. No consumer, fixture or source PASS writes an audit, releases a reservation or admits a job; that needs the separate five-part parent transaction. Fixture decisions never enter the plan audit directory.
deterministic_rules: Strict types: bool never int; counts exact ints >= 0; hashes 64 lowercase hex; paths absolute and normalized (no empty, '.', '..' component, no NUL); names plain; JSON-typed deep equality for argv, pins and date records (nesting <= 32).

Ownership: expected_exit/actual_exit -> X1; capture_paths.stdout + captures.stdout -> X2; capture_paths.stderr + captures.stderr -> X3 (capture_paths container defects or equal paths -> both); outputs, job_dir, artifacts, actual_artifact_names -> X4; settlement -> X6; top-level not-dict/key-set/format deviations and all remaining fields -> X7. An absent top-level field fires X7 and its owner.

Per stream at most one subcause: MISSING (record absent/null or present exactly false) > INCOMPLETE (anything else not a verified complete capture: record keys, present true, path equal to the declared path, hex digest, bytes_seen == bytes_stored <= 16 MiB, eof true, overflow false, error null, re-read length and digest) > content. Extra captures keys make non-missing streams INCOMPLETE.
X2 content: the verified complete stdout bytes must equal the actual bytes read at job_dir + '/result.json', which must be a declared output; byte equality only (canonical single line is X5).
X3 content: the verified complete stderr bytes must be empty.
X1: expected_exit exact int in 0..255 and actual_exit exact int equal to it; negative signals never match.

X4: outputs 1..256 distinct plain names including result.json; job_dir bound; census equals outputs as a set of distinct plain names; artifacts keys equal outputs; each record exact keys, path == job_dir + '/' + name, hex digest, bytes count <= 16 MiB, ino exact int > 0, nlink exact int 1; re-read length and digest equal. Actual dev/ino identity is the reader's obligation.
X6: settlement exact keys; reaped, group_empty, census_complete exactly true; unresolved and signals exact empty lists.

X7: both record formats and exact key sets; mode in PLAN/FIXTURE and equal; nonempty equal item; plan_sha256 equal on both sides and equal to the contract authority plan 254b44c3...a59731; receipt path normalized and outside job_dir, digest hex, observation receipt exact keys and equal, re-read digest equal; resolved_argv nonempty list of str and exactly equal; go_sha256 hex and equal; source_pins and input_pins each 1..256 normalized paths to hex digests, exactly equal, every pinned file re-read to its digest; date_start/date_end nonempty objects exactly equal.
Capture and receipt paths must lie outside job_dir and the two capture paths must differ, so no job output can stand in for a capture or receipt.

discrepancy_dispositions_parent_agreed: Mapping v1 X2 includes 'not exactly one final LF'; the consumer contract makes X2 byte equality with the actual result.json and leaves the canonical single line to X5. Implemented: X2 byte equality only.

Approved ext3 sensitivity provenance does not artificially produce X7: if the FIXTURE expectation binds the approved ext3 invocation, audit_capture gives S1-shaped evidence [] and S2-shaped [X1]; superseded source/program hash mismatch belongs to X5 (audit_schema).
Mapping X6 'census hit' has no observation field: census hits live in settlement.unresolved; no field added.
Fault plan v1 'one decision {verdict, causes}' versus contract 'returns causes only': contract governs; the parent composes any decision.

Per-case expected causes are frozen by the parent adapter/test plan, not by the old mapping; N1 driver v1 stays HOLD and its receipt lacks plan/GO/mode/item, so those are parent attestations in any successor.
implementation_choices_where_contract_is: Defined reader failures are OSError and ValueError (gate reader convention); any other exception propagates.
One read cap of 16 MiB (successor4 v3 plan/source-pin/artifact cap) for every read; larger declared counts fail their owner.
At most 256 declared outputs, census names and entries per pin map.
X4 requires result.json among the declared outputs.
Capture/receipt paths outside job_dir; distinct capture paths.
plan_sha256 pinned to the contract authority plan in both modes; a fixture expectation naming another plan fails X7.
Date records: nonempty JSON objects with exact typed equality; inner fields not interpreted.
Declared ino checked syntactically (> 0); actual identity left to the anchored reader.
